clues.it: Fabio era nella 8ª colonna, accanto a un lampadario e a nord di Luca.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 8th column, beside a chandelier and north of Luca.

clues.it: Tea era nella 6ª colonna e accanto a un baule da viaggio, ma non era accanto a dei bicchieri rotti.
clues.en: Tea was in the 6th column and beside a steamer trunk, but was not beside broken glasses.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 9ª colonna e nella Suite Reale, ma non era accanto a un grammofono.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 9th column and in the Royal Suite, but was not beside a gramophone.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 12ª colonna, nella 4ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Marta.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 12th column, in the 4th row and in the same room as Marta.

clues.it: Bruno era accanto a un baule da viaggio, in una stanza diversa da Luca e al Ristorante.
clues.en: Bruno was beside a steamer trunk, in a different room from Luca and in the Restaurant.

clues.it: Vito era nella 6ª riga, in una stanza diversa da Bruno e nella Suite Reale.
clues.en: Vito was in the 6th row, in a different room from Bruno and in the Royal Suite.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Marta era nella 10ª colonna, nella 8ª riga e nella stessa stanza di Ugo.
clues.en: Marta was in the 10th column, in the 8th row and in the same room as Ugo.

clues.it: Elena era nella 9ª riga e accanto a un tavolo da biliardo.
clues.en: Elena was in the 9th row and beside a billiard table.

clues.it: Dario era accanto a un baule da viaggio e in una stanza diversa da Luca.
clues.en: Dario was beside a steamer trunk and in a different room from Luca.

clues.it: Nino era nella 4ª colonna, accanto a un grammofono e a ovest di Bruno.
clues.en: Nino was in the 4th column, beside a gramophone and west of Bruno.

clues.it: Luca era accanto a un tappeto persiano e a ovest di Vito.
clues.en: Luca was beside a persian carpet and west of Vito.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: Ugo può stare solo nella 4ª riga: escludendola, a Bruno resta una sola casella: riga 5ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Ugo can only be in the 4th row: ruling it out leaves Bruno a single square: row 5th, column 5th.
